name: LandCover.ai
tagline: Mapping buildings, woodland, water and roads from orthophotos
modality: Polish aerial orthophotos · RGB · 25–50 cm · 512×512 tiles
description: 41 aerial orthophotos covering 216 km² of rural Poland, hand-annotated for buildings, woodland, water and roads, cut into 512×512 tiles by the dataset's official split.py. The hub keeps the official train/val tiles and halves the official test tiles (seeded) into test_public and test_hidden. Classes are heavily imbalanced: buildings and roads are a few percent of pixels, so mIoU — not pixel accuracy — is primary.
citation: Boguszewski et al. LandCover.ai: Dataset for Automatic Mapping of Buildings, Woodlands, Water and Roads from Aerial Imagery. CVPR Workshops, 2021.

metrics.name: miou
metrics.label: mIoU
metrics.description: Mean intersection-over-union across classes (dataset-level, accumulated over all hidden pixels).

metrics.name: pixel_accuracy
metrics.label: Pixel acc.
metrics.description: Fraction of correctly labelled pixels — dominated by the majority class.

metrics.name: fw_iou
metrics.label: FW-IoU
metrics.description: Frequency-weighted IoU (classes weighted by pixel share).

format_spec.rows: one 512×512 single-channel PNG per test_hidden tile
